config.title: German Unity Day in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: What 3 October changes in Berlin: which shops close, where groceries still work, what museums and transport do, and what is actually happening in the city.

items.q: Is everything closed in Berlin on 3 October?
items.a: No. Shops close the way they do on a Sunday, so **malls, supermarkets and most stores stay shut**. Restaurants, cafes and bars run a normal Saturday, **museums open as on a Sunday**, bakeries may sell from **07:00 to 16:00**, and station and airport shops stay open all day.

items.q: Where can I buy groceries on German Unity Day in Berlin?
items.a: Use the station supermarkets: **REWE Ostbahnhof (06:00 to 24:00)**, **REWE Hauptbahnhof (about 08:00 to 22:00)**, **EDEKA Friedrichstrasse and EDEKA Suedkreuz (about 08:00 to 22:00)**, denn's Biomarkt at Gesundbrunnen, Zoo, Ostkreuz and Hauptbahnhof, and the REWE in **BER Terminal 1 (05:00 to 24:00)**. Check the store page for the exact day before you rely on one.

items.q: Are Berlin museums open on 3 October?
items.a: Yes. The Staatliche Museen state that on Saturday 3 October 2026 **all their museums open as on a Sunday**, which for most houses means about 10:00 to 18:00. The **Deutsches Historisches Museum offers free admission to its Pei building** on Unity Day. Book timed tickets ahead; a holiday Saturday fills the popular slots.

items.q: Is there a big celebration in Berlin on 3 October 2026?
items.a: The official national celebration moves between federal states, and in 2026 it is **in Bremen, not Berlin**, from 2 to 4 October. In Berlin the weekend still has plenty: **TAG DER CLUBKULTUR opens on 3 October**, Spandau Citadel runs a **medieval festival on 3 and 4 October**, and the annual Open Mosque Day falls on the holiday itself.

items.q: Does public transport run on German Unity Day?
items.a: Yes. U-Bahn, S-Bahn, trams and buses run on the **Sunday timetable**, and because 3 October 2026 is a Saturday, the usual **all-night weekend service** runs as well. Airport connections including the **S9 and the FEX** operate normally.
